question: In the frozen Binance V1.7 12H close-signal capacity/funding account, does changing only the initial quantity assigned to the existing 2R limit improve funded results?
single_variable: Change only the share of each original parent position assigned to its existing 2R target: primary f=1/3, opposite control f=5/6, and reuse the frozen f=2/3 account as baseline. Each parent keeps four native child legs with weights [f/2,f/2,(1-f)/2,(1-f)/2]. Preserve the original parent IDs, V1.7 signal clocks, entry order and slots, native prices, stop and EMA exits, 1x/2x exposure map, prior-minute capacity, fees, hourly trims, funding source and funding boundary scenarios.

account.entry_capacity_window: Median quote turnover of exactly 60 complete Binance USD-M 1m bars in [entry_ms - 60 minutes, entry_ms); entry minute is excluded.
account.signal_execution_clock: Original V1.7 12H close confirmation at entry_ms; execute at the coincident native Binance H1 open. The original event_id timestamp is the signal close in milliseconds encoded as nanoseconds.
account.stops_and_exits: Keep the frozen original protective stop, 2R limit, runner EMA exit and any archived expiry/forced close unchanged. Do not change prices or admission based on this experiment.
account.entry_priority: Preserve the frozen V1.7 entry order, CRC32 priority and native nine-slot assignments. The three unknown prior-minute capacity opportunities leave their original slots empty.

funding.accounting: Use the existing archived fundingRate and official mark inputs at their source millisecond. Apply actual child-leg signed quantity; funding changes shared cash and subsequent size. Preserve the existing collateral-liability handling.
funding.source_policy: Reuse the complete frozen funding tape and its source_months/source_coverage receipts; no downloads or substituted prices.

reporting.cash_bridge: Initial cash + native VectorBT order cashflows + actually applied funding cashflows = terminal NAV; later order sizes may differ, so funding is not a terminal-only adjustment.
reporting.baseline: Reuse the committed 2/3 target-fraction capacity/funding account outputs without re-running them.

execution.framework: Local VectorBT 1.2.0 from_order_func cash-sharing account with the existing native four-stage funding and hourly-trim callback.
execution.network_policy: Offline replay only; no funding collection, price download, alternate venue, or new entry generation.
execution.change_boundary: Only child_weights at initial parent sizing changes; all four legs remain present and funded in the same account.
execution.capacity_and_risk: Keep the 10% prior-minute entry cap and 20% prior-completed-H1 NAV per-contract trim active in every run.
